boundary.book: Python Engine Core matcher · synthetic depth only · report timing here is a declared illustration, not historical queue reconstruction.
boundary.cost: Python Engine Core minute owner · synthetic cash reconciliation · opportunity shortfall is descriptive, never a second cash fee.

boundary.impact: Python Engine Core LinearImpact · synthetic sensitivity · coefficients uncalibrated; the reference has zero nondecaying component.
boundary.lots: Python Engine Core discrete inventory solver · exhaustive optimum only within this tiny declared grid · no general nonconvex guarantee.
boundary.paths: Python Engine Core minute execution · independently rerun accounts and feedback · synthetic paths, no additional independent real-market samples.
boundary.risk: Engine Core financial checkpoints, restrictions and allocation; Platform descriptive risk analysis · synthetic acceptance · Runtime process recovery has separate evidence; no executable liquidation claim.
boundary.selection: Public null-signal generator + finite teaching enumeration · six retained attempts · not PBO/CSCV and not a real out-of-sample result.
